explanation: Record the best one-transaction profit for every prefix. Scan backward while maintaining the best sale price to combine a second transaction with each prefix result. The file also contains a separate constant-space alternative.
timeComplexity: O(n) time for the called prefix/suffix implementation.
spaceComplexity: O(n) auxiliary space for prefix profits.
